subject: Insular Health — enclave spot additions and renewal timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Lydia Shaw <lydia.shaw@insularhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@insularhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Insular Health — enclave spot additions and renewal timeline

Hi Lydia / Procurement,

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last month. Per our call, I wanted to put a short written summary and proposed next steps for adding standby "spot" enclaves to your Private deployment alongside the upcoming renewal.

Summary of ask:
- Add two standby on-prem enclaves in APAC and US-East for regional failover (each is a 4-GPU cluster).
- Extend the contract term from 12 to 24 months to cover the expansion and secure pricing.
- Request a small SLA exception window during the cutover week so we can run seed traffic.

What I’m attaching: a revised proposal (insular_proposal_v2.pdf) and a high-level topology diagram (topology_diagram.png). The proposal includes an amortized one-time provisioning fee + monthly reserved capacity.

Questions for procurement:
1) Is a 24-month term acceptable for your finance team?
2) Any PO / billing constraints (separate POs per site, single PO, or marketplace purchase)?
3) Preferred date window for migration/cutover—we typically recommend a 7-day maintenance window.

Proposed next steps
- You review the attached proposal and share any redlines.
- If the scope is good, we’ll issue an updated SOW and DocuSign package.
- Coordinate a migration window in Jan (we have capacity the week of Jan 15–21).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks, Hannah — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement prefers a single annual PO per calendar year, but we can scope the 24-month term across two POs if needed. I’ll confirm with finance and get back to you on whether they’ll accept a multi-year PO.
- Security wants to run a quick follow-up: can you send SOC 2 and the latest data retention/audit logs doc? Our security architect will also want a short Q&A on network segmentation for the standby nodes.
- We like the Jan 15–21 window; will need a tentative date so we can block internal teams.

Attaching a note from procurement requesting a cost breakdown that separates one-time provisioning fees from monthly reserved capacity. They also asked for a sample invoice format.

I can introduce you to our procurement lead if that would speed things up — copied above.

Best,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 13:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Insular Health — enclave spot additions and renewal timeline

Hannah — draft numbers and technical notes below (short version). I attached a detailed cost sheet offline (kv-cache-plan.xlsx).

Pricing (draft):
- One-time provisioning: $45,000 per enclave (hardware + setup + initial validation).
- Monthly reserved capacity: $23,500 per enclave per month (includes reserved GPUs, monitoring, and 24x7 support).
- If they want standby to accept warm traffic, recommend a low-cost burst tier of $3,000/mo per enclave.

Technical notes / risk flags:
- Network segmentation: standby enclaves will be isolated in their own VPC with limited peering. Security will want a short runbook for cross-VPC auth (we can provide presigned certificates + mTLS config).
- KV cache seeding: estimate ~18 hours of sustained warm traffic to reach steady-state for the two enclaves. During that time, request the SLA exception for token latency spikes.
- Data residency: confirm that logs from failover windows will be covered under existing retention policy.

I recommend we provide: SOC 2 snapshot + a 1-page network FAQ and sample invoice template. I’ll sync with Kim on the legal language for the SOW addendum.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Runtime Engineering, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: kv-cache-plan.xlsx (detailed cost & sizing)

Thanks, Karthik and team — this looks good and addresses our procurement questions. Procurement has asked me to confirm a couple small points but we’re prepared to move forward in principle:

- We agree to a 24-month term with the two standby enclaves. Please prepare a DocuSign SOW + amendment reflecting the one-time provisioning fees and the monthly reserved capacity.
- Procurement will issue a single PO for the first 12 months upon signature; the second-year PO will be issued at the start of year two. That works for our finance model.
- Approved migration window: January 18–21, 2027 (please hold those dates).

Please send DocuSign and a sample invoice format. If you can include SOC 2 snapshot and the 1-page network FAQ in the DocuSign package, that will speed approvals.

Best,
Lydia
